name: 39475 · Purvis, MS
findings: ZIP 39475 (Purvis) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39475 (Purvis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
